fields.duties:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.


FieldAI is seeking an Account Executive to drive growth within the construction industry by helping customers adopt autonomous robotics solutions that improve project execution, operational visibility, productivity, and safety.
This role will focus on developing relationships with General Contractors, Owners, and other key construction stakeholders, identifying opportunities to solve real-world operational challenges, and driving new business growth. You will work closely with customers, technical teams, and deployment teams to bring innovative technology into complex construction environments.
The ideal candidate understands how construction projects operate, has experience selling solutions used in the field, and is comfortable navigating complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.


What You'll Do
Develop and grow relationships with General Contractors, Owners, Developers, and other construction industry stakeholders
Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities
Lead complex sales cycles from initial engagement through contract execution
Partner closely with technical and deployment teams to align FieldAI solutions with customer needs
Build strategic account plans that drive long-term customer growth and expansion
Represent FieldAI at customer sites, industry events, and key customer meetings
Maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently deliver against revenue objectives

What You Bring
3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience
Experience selling into construction organizations, including General Contractors, Owners, Developers, or similar stakeholders
Track record of closing large, complex deals involving multiple decision-makers
Strong understanding of construction workflows, project stakeholders, and operational challenges
Excellent communication, relationship-building, and consultative selling skills
Ability to travel regularly and work closely with customers onsite

What Sets You Apart
Experience selling construction technology, robotics, automation, or other solutions used directly in field operations and project execution
Existing relationships within the construction industry
Experience partnering with technical, implementation, or deployment teams throughout the customer lifecycle
Passion for helping customers adopt innovative technologies that transform how work gets done

Our salary range is generous and we consider each individual’s background and experience when determining final compensation. Base pay may vary based on role scope, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the Irvine, California market.
 
Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?
In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.
You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.
 
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.
 
Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.
 
We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

fields.duties:
About Field AI
Field AI is building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready physical AI systems that enable autonomous robots to operate in the world's most challenging environments. Our technology is deployed across diverse industrial sites, helping customers improve safety, efficiency, and operational performance.
About the Role
We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to drive enterprise sales across strategic industrial markets. You'll own the full sales cycle, build executive relationships, and help some of the world's largest organizations adopt autonomous robotics solutions.
What You'll Do
Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting to close.
Develop strategic relationships with executive and operational leaders.
Identify customer challenges and position Field AI's autonomous robotics solutions.
Lead customer presentations, pilots, and commercial negotiations.
Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Deployment teams to ensure customer success.
Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline and accurate forecasts.
Represent FieldAI at customer meetings and industry events.
Consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.
As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll collaborate with world-class engineers, product leaders, and industry experts to shape solutions around customer needs and accelerate the adoption of autonomous systems at scale. Your work will have a direct impact on business growth, customer success, and the evolution of our technology and go-to-market strategy.
What We're Looking For
8+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience with a proven track record of closing complex deals.
Experience selling into one or more of the following industries:
Manufacturing
Energy and utilities
Oil and gas
Mining and metals
Chemicals
Transportation and logistics
Industrial equipment
Food & Agriculture
Aerospace & Defense
Strong experience selling to VP and C-level executives.
Experience with robotics, AI, industrial automation, autonomous systems, industrial software, or related technologies preferred.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to travel up to 25%.
Why Join Field AI?
Join a hyper growth robotics company bringing cutting-edge autonomous technology to real-world customers. You'll work with world-class engineers, solve meaningful customer challenges and be part of an incredible sales team representing the best tech in the industry. This is an opportunity to join at a pivotal stage, take meaningful ownership, and help define the future of robotics in industries where safety, productivity, and resilience matter most.

title: Principal Sales Engineer – Warehouse Robotics Systems

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
We are seeking a Principal Sales Engineer to own the technical modeling and system design process that underpins every enterprise deal we close. This role sits at the intersection of sales, engineering, and product strategy — you will architect quantitative models used to size and justify our warehouse robotics systems while serving as the primary feedback loop between market-facing teams and our engineering and product organizations. This is a high-visibility, high-impact position with a direct line to influence the product roadmap.
Responsibilities
Develop and own quantitative models for designing and sizing warehouse robotics systems, including throughput simulations, labor displacement analyses, ROI models, and operational workflow configurations.
Translate complex customer data — order profiles, SKU velocity, floor layouts, labor rates, WMS integrations — into optimized system designs with clearly justified recommendations.
Build and continuously refine modeling tools, templates, and frameworks that enable consistent, scalable operation across the sales engineering team.
Lead design reviews with internal engineering teams and customer stakeholders, presenting technical solutions accessibly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with account executives across the full sales cycle — qualification through proposal, technical validation, and close.
Lead technical discovery sessions with operations, engineering, and executive-level stakeholders at prospective customers.
Construct business cases and ROI analyses translating system capabilities into measurable outcomes: units per hour, labor cost reduction, order accuracy, and capital payback period.
Serve as the primary conduit between market-facing teams and internal engineering and product management, capturing customer objections, competitive differentiators, and unmet requirements.
Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and maintain a structured gap analysis framework to drive prioritized product requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
7+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or systems engineering within warehouse automation, material handling, or supply chain technology.
Demonstrated expertise building throughput models, simulation analyses, or operational designs for automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, AMRs, conveyor/sortation, goods-to-person).
Deep knowledge of warehouse operations: order fulfillment workflows, labor management, WMS/WCS architecture, inbound/outbound processes, and peak planning.
Proficiency with simulation or modeling tools (AutoMod, Emulate3D, FlexSim, or equivalent); custom modeling in Excel or Python a strong plus.
Familiarity with WMS/WCS systems and integration requirements (API, EDI, SOAP/REST).
Ability to read and interpret facility drawings, floor plans, and AutoCAD files.
Exceptional communicator comfortable presenting to both VP of Operations and CFO-level stakeholders in the same meeting.
Willingness to travel to customer sites (~40–50%).
Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, or related technical discipline; Master's or MBA a plus.
Background working with or for 3PLs, large-format retailers, or e-commerce fulfillment operations preferred.
Base Salary Range
$100,000
—
$300,000 USD

This is a high-visibility, high-impact position with a direct line to influence the product roadmap.
Responsibilities
Develop and own quantitative models for designing and sizing warehouse robotics systems, including throughput simulations, labor displacement analyses, ROI models, and operational workflow configurations.
Translate complex customer data — order profiles, SKU velocity, floor layouts, labor rates, WMS integrations — into optimized system designs with clearly justified recommendations.
Build and continuously refine modeling tools, templates, and frameworks that enable consistent, scalable operation across the sales engineering team.
Lead design reviews with internal engineering teams and customer stakeholders, presenting technical solutions accessibly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with account executives across the full sales cycle — qualification through proposal, technical validation, and close.
Lead technical discovery sessions with operations, engineering, and executive-level stakeholders at prospective customers.
Construct business cases and ROI analyses translating system capabilities into measurable outcomes: units per hour, labor cost reduction, order accuracy, and capital payback period.
Serve as the primary conduit between market-facing teams and internal engineering and product management, capturing customer objections, competitive differentiators, and unmet requirements.
Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and maintain a structured gap analysis framework to drive prioritized product requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
7+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or systems engineering within warehouse automation, material handling, or supply chain technology.
Demonstrated expertise building throughput models, simulation analyses, or operational designs for automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, AMRs, conveyor/sortation, goods-to-person).
Deep knowledge of warehouse operations: order fulfillment workflows, labor management, WMS/WCS architecture, inbound/outbound processes, and peak planning.
Proficiency with simulation or modeling tools (AutoMod, Emulate3D, FlexSim, or equivalent); custom modeling in Excel or Python a strong plus.
Familiarity with WMS/WCS systems and integration requirements (API, EDI, SOAP/REST).
Ability to read and interpret facility drawings, floor plans, and AutoCAD files.
Exceptional communicator comfortable presenting to both VP of Operations and CFO-level stakeholders in the same meeting.
Willingness to travel to customer sites (~40–50%).
Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, or related technical discipline; Master's or MBA a plus.
Background working with or for 3PLs, large-format retailers, or e-commerce fulfillment operations preferred.
Base Salary Range
$100,000
—
$300,000 USD

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
We're looking for a senior-level contract designer to lead the visual design of a full 360 brand campaign — from early concepting and brand system development through to final production-ready assets. You'll work directly with our creative director to build something that communicates what we're doing without sounding like every other AI company.
Responsibilities
Lead visual concepting and brand system development from a blank brief.
Design and deliver production-ready assets across website, digital, social, and out-of-home.
Collaborate with the creative director to ensure visual decisions reflect brand positioning.
Contribute strategic creative input throughout the brand building process.
Preferred Qualifications
Proven track record of building brands from zero — identity, campaign, print, and digital.
Strong strategic sensibility; you think about positioning before you open a file.
Portfolio that shows range and a distinctive point of view.
Experience in AI, robotics, or deep tech is a genuine plus.
*Please include your portfolio and a brief note on a project you're proud of — what the brief was, what you made, and why it worked.
